lines.1: 「Morning, young lady (← just being polite). Coming in.」
lines.2: 「Leo, I'm sorry you have to do this every day. All for that dud.」
lines.3: 「If even I give up on her, her life is guaranteed to go into a nonstop nosedive.」
lines.4: 「Would you like to take that thing as your bride?」
lines.5: 「I think I'll pass on a daughter who tried to eat calcium chalk because she said it'd make her bones stronger.」
lines.6: 「Fair enough. If I were a man, I wouldn't want her either.」
lines.10: Her sleeping position is as spectacular as ever.
lines.13: 「Look at that stupid face she's making in her sleep...」
lines.14: 「...Yeah... I guess I'm the only one who can eat it... I'll take Leo's share off his hands... He'd better thank me...」
lines.15: What is this moron dreaming about?
